title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Handling Trust Funds
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A client hands a paralegal $1,500 in cash as an advance retainer for upcoming work on a Human Rights Tribunal application. Where must the paralegal immediately deposit these funds?
options: Into the paralegal's general operating account, provided they issue a receipt.
Into the paralegal's personal bank account until the work is completed.
Into a designated mixed trust account.
Into a safety deposit box controlled by the paralegal.
questions.explain: LSO By-law 9 strictly requires that any money received in advance of services being rendered (unearned retainer) must be deposited immediately into a designated mixed trust account. It can only be transferred to the general account after the work has been billed.
